name: Ecommerce Frauds Check
author: Frauds Check

sections.description:
Ecommerce Frauds Check is a powerful WooCommerce plugin that helps online merchants protect their business by identifying fraudulent orders before they result in cancellations or chargebacks. By using this service, merchants can detect the possibility of fraud in their orders by checking if a customer has a history of fraudulent activity. This can help merchants make informed decisions and minimize risks, ultimately saving time and reducing revenue loss.

Features:

  • Detect fraudulent orders by checking customer history.
  • Integrated with WooCommerce for easy setup and management.
  • Automatically syncs orders every hour to ensure up-to-date fraud detection.
  • Search for orders by phone number.
  • Provide feedback on suspicious phone numbers to track potential fraud.

How it works:

The plugin connects to the FraudsCheck API, which provides data on whether a customer has a history of fraudulent orders. When an order is placed, it is checked for fraudulent activity and flagged if necessary. Merchants can view the fraud status directly in the WooCommerce dashboard.

Privacy Policy

Our plugin collects data for fraud detection purposes. To learn more about how we collect and use your data, please visit Privacy Policy.

Terms of Service

By using this plugin, you agree to our Terms of Service. Please read them here: Terms of Service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ecommerce-frauds-check folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Start detecting fraud and providing feedback on suspicious phone numbers!

  • Ability to search orders by phone number and provide feedback on suspicious activity.
  • API sync set to run every hour to keep data up-to-date.
  • Admin interface with easy-to-use search functionality for phone numbers and order details.
